_help: Single source for every date on the site. date: YYYY-MM-DD or null (shown as 'to be announced'). time: 'HH:MM' in the site time zone (content/site.json) or null for whole-day events. status: confirmed | tentative. countdown: true lets the event appear as the next deadline. endDate: optional, for multi-day events.
